Subject:
CHANGE/APPOINTMENTOFMD/CEOOGDCL
Dear Sir,
In continuation of our letter No. CS04-08/PSX dated October 14, 2021 (enclosed), it is
informed that Mr. Shahid Salim Khan has relinquished the charge of MD/CEO of the company on
October 20, 2021 and Syed Khalid Siraj Subhani has assumed the charge of the office with
immediate effect.
The above information is submitted in compliance with PSX Regulations / Code of
Corporate Governance for dissemination amongst your members please.
Yours truly,
(Ahmed Hayat Lak)
Company Secretary

ItisherebyinformedthatOGDCLBoardofDirectorsinits24othmeetingheldon
October14,2021approved/resolvedasunder:
A.Resignation of Mr.Shahid Salim Khan,MD/CEO be and is hereby accepted.He wil
relinquishthechargeofofficeofMD/CEOonOctober20,2021.
B.SyedKhalid Siraj Subhani,Directorwill assume the dutiesof theoffice ofMD/CEOon
acting charge basis uponrelinquishmentof charge by Mr.Shahid Salim Khanon
October20,2021.
